meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 当 xAI 账号已连接时,Claude 会用 x_search 工具检索 X(推特)帖子:给时效性查询限定日期、限定可信账号,把查询拆成 2~3 次,并和网页搜索结果相互对照。
howto.when: 当你提到「X 搜索」「推特搜索」「推文」等关键词,或想知道 X 上的人在说什么时触发;前提是已连接 xAI 账号,没连时会说明 x_search 不可用并改用 web_search。

say.text: 搜一下 X 上最近两天关于英伟达的帖子
say.note: 会自动限定日期并按账号、关键词分开搜

say.text: 看看 @growth_papa 昨天发了什么
say.note: 按你点名的可信账号限定搜索范围

say.text: 搜 X 上关于这条新闻的反应,再和网页搜索对一下
say.note: 会同时跑网页搜索并指出两者是否一致

howto.what_en: When an xAI account is connected, Claude uses the x_search tool to search X (Twitter) posts: it date-bounds time-sensitive queries, limits them to trusted handles, splits them into 2-3 searches, and reconciles results against web_search.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention X search, Twitter search or tweets, or ask what people are saying on X. Needs a connected xAI account; otherwise Claude says x_search is unavailable and uses web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for posts about Nvidia from the last two days

say_en.note: Scopes the search to trusted handles

say_en.text: Search X for reaction to this news and check it against web search
say_en.note: Also runs web_search and flags mismatches
